title: Project Conspiracy
setting: A sprawling desert wasteland dotted with scrap yards
theme: The conspiracy behind a corporation that controls dreams
camera_style: Shaky handheld camera and intense close-ups
prompt: A Post-Apocalyptic Survival movie set in a sprawling desert wasteland dotted with scrap yards. The story explores the theme of the conspiracy behind a corporation that controls dreams. The visual style is retro vhs aesthetic with a teal and orange color palette. The camera work features shaky handheld camera and intense close-ups to create a whimsical & poetic atmosphere with slow-burn & atmospheric pacing.
